'''Vault K-23''' was the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] designation for a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] vault located in the northeastern corner of the [[Varactyl Vale]], an area of the [[Minimum Security Section]] of the Republic's [[Belsavis prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]] during the [[Galactic War]], [[Havoc Squad]] rendezvoused with [[Dagger Wing]] in Vault K-23 after recovering medical supplies for the wing's injured pilots, and repelled an Imperial incursion into the vault.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Vault K-23 appears as a class-restricted phase on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where the Trooper class mission "Change In Plans" occurs.<ref name="TOR" />
